title: docs: remove stale T2 → T3 migration appendices
body:
Removes 6 stale `T2 → T3 migration` appendices that should have come out when T3 was promoted to mainnet on **Apr 27, 2026** — over a month ago, well past the integrator cooldown period the "will be removed in a future docs revision" note was meant to cover.

Follow-up to #450 (T5 content sweep) — splitting the cleanup into its own PR per review feedback.

## Files

| Page | What was removed |
|------|------------------|
| `protocol/tip20/spec.mdx` | Virtual-address recipient resolution notes (already covered inline in the [Virtual Address Recipients](https://docs.tempo.xyz/protocol/tip20/spec#virtual-address-recipients) section above) |
| `protocol/tip20-rewards/spec.mdx` | `setRewardRecipient` virtual-address rejection note |
| `protocol/tip403/spec.mdx` | Virtual-address rejection in policy config + master-wallet resolution notes |
| `protocol/transactions/AccountKeychain.mdx` | 110-line legacy T2 interface block, T2 vs T3 selector tables, and migration summary |
| `protocol/transactions/spec-tempo-transaction.mdx` | Pre-T3 `KeyAuthorization` Rust struct + digest reference block |
| `sdk/foundry/index.mdx` | Post-T3 `cast` selector check (redundant with the canonical `cast keychain` examples already on the page) |

## Verification

```
$ pnpm upgrade:coverage --cleanup t3   # added in #450
✅ No stale "Coming with T3" or "T2 → T3 migration" blocks found.

$ pnpm check && pnpm check:types
# both clean
```
